mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in WORKPLACES with elevated RESIDENTIAL indicates fewer out-of-home weekdays, which suppresses retail visits over the next four weeks. If commuting remains weak, RETAIL_REC should stay below its recent four-week average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages above its prior 28-day mean even though WORKPLACES stays below -10 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -25, access friction to shopping corridors increases and retail-and-recreation mobility drops within one week. The signal should be visible as a further short-run decrease in RETAIL_REC after the crossing.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -25, or it rises instead.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM together with a rebound in PARKS signals more local discretionary movement and errands, which spills over into retail visits over the next two weeks. If both series improve at the same time, RETAIL_REC should rise relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next 14 days even though GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both increase by at least 5 points from their current weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES drops by more than 10 points week-on-week while TRANSIT also weakens, the combined restriction-like mobility shock will translate into lower retail activity over the next four weeks. The decline should be strongest when both series move down together.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its last-28-day mean within four weeks after a large WORKPLACES drop, especially if TRANSIT also fails to weaken.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL combined with a fall in TRANSIT means people are staying closer to home and making fewer shopping trips. That pattern should depress RETAIL_REC over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +10 and TRANSIT staying below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PARKS below -10 marks a weather- or season-linked pullback in leisure outings, and retail-and-recreation mobility follows downward within two weeks. The effect should appear even if other categories are stable.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after PARKS drops below -10, or it rises while PARKS remains depressed.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in GROCERY_PHARM above its recent level signals resumed routine trips that often precede broader retail activity. Over four weeks, that routine-mobility recovery should lift RETAIL_REC above the prior month average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 28-day mean for the full next month even though GROCERY_PHARM remains positive.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and TRANSIT both recover from their current depressed levels, discretionary out-of-home activity broadens beyond necessities and retail mobility strengthens. The uplift should appear within one to two weeks after the joint recovery.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 7 to 14 days after PARKS and TRANSIT both rise by at least 5 points from their current weekly means.
